sources.entry: WebTorrent Desktop - Streaming torrent app. For Mac, Windows, and Linux.

summary.one_liner: WebTorrent Desktop is a streaming torrent app for Mac, Windows, and Linux, built with Electron, React, and Material UI.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes WebTorrent Desktop as a streaming torrent app for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Users can download the app from the official website, grab installer files from GitHub releases, or install it on macOS via Homebrew Cask. The README also covers developer workflows: cloning the repo, running the app with npm start, a watch mode that restarts on code changes, lint and integration test scripts, and packaging binaries for each platform. Packaging options include deb, rpm, zip, dmg, exe, and portable outputs, with optional code signing. The app collects basic anonymous usage stats (for example, play button success rate), and the README says it does not send personally identifying information or track which torrents are added.
use_cases: stream a torrent video while it downloads
play torrent movies without waiting for full download
install a torrent client on macOS, Windows, or Linux
develop or modify an Electron torrent app
package desktop binaries for multiple platforms
notable: Streams torrent video while downloading, per the description
Available as a Homebrew Cask on macOS
Packages for Mac, Windows, and Linux, including deb, rpm, dmg, exe, and portable formats
Integration tests use screenshot diffing against reference images
Usage stats are described as excluding personally identifying info and torrent names
caveats: The development version is described as unstable
Mac packaging requires macOS; Windows code signing requires Windows
Packaging Windows from other platforms needs Wine and Mono; integration tests need specific screen resolutions and setups
